title: Epistle connectors and argument
subtitle: Follow the author’s reasons, contrasts, and conclusions.
overview: Epistles make arguments through connective words. A paragraph map should show why a clause is there, not merely that it is grammatically subordinate.
Notice especially γάρ (support), οὖν (inference), διό (therefore), and ἵνα (purpose or intended outcome).

items.grc: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι ... οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων, ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται.
items.en: For by grace you have been saved ... not from works, so that no one may boast.
Therefore I exhort you to walk worthily.
